_: National orthophoto services, one per country, read from the services
themselves on 06.10.2026.
🔴 WHY THIS FILE IS DATA AND NOT CODE. Every field below was read from a
primary source and every one carries the URL it was read from and the
date. The mockup for 03-map.html settled the policy — 'Esri, Bing and
Google are closed to us by licence; orthophotos come from national open
sources' — but a policy is not a licence. 'Open' is a word; CC BY 4.0
with a named attribution string is a term.
🔴 AND A SERVICE SAYING 'none' IS NOT A LICENCE EITHER. PDOK's WMTS
declares ows:Fees none and ows:AccessConstraints none, which means the
service put nothing in those fields — not that the imagery is free of
conditions. That is why the Netherlands is listed under `notYet` with
what is missing, rather than switched on.
`providerShort` is the name the provider credits itself by, which is not
always the first words of its legal name: IGN France signs its data "IGN",
not "Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière". The
check requires the attribution to contain it, so a credit that names
nobody cannot pass.
Refresh by re-reading each `readFrom` URL. A licence that nobody can
reproduce from a link is a licence we are quoting from memory.

notYet.whatIsKnown: The WMTS at https://service.pdok.nl/hwh/luchtfotorgb/wmts/v1_0 serves layer Actueel_orthoHR and declares ows:Fees "none" and ows:AccessConstraints "none".
notYet.whyNotEnabled: Neither field is a licence. PDOK's own copyright page names CC-BY-4.0 for specific datasets (BRT Achtergrondkaart, Bestuurlijke Grenzen, TOPraster, TOPNL) and says the terms for every other dataset live in its Nationaal Georegister metadata record, 'determined by the data provider themselves'. That record — uuid bc9b2d88-9d6b-46c9-ad0e-23f0b7da657c — answered with an HTML login page rather than the XML, so the licence and the required bronvermelding were not read from a primary source. Secondary sources say CC BY 4.0 with attribution to Samenwerkingsverband Beeldmateriaal, which is probably right and is not good enough to publish on.
notYet.howToClose: Fetch the NGR record as XML (the API path, not the UI path) or ask BeheerPDOK@kadaster.nl, and quote mco:otherConstraints the way the Spanish and French entries do.
